component.name: Compass
component.summary: A fast, extensible command palette for Linux

description.p: Compass is a native command palette: application search, clipboard history, snippets, file search, a calculator, an emoji picker and a window switcher, extensible with Raycast-compatible extensions and script commands.
It is a memory-safe Rust rewrite of the Vicinae launcher, drawn with Iced and wgpu instead of Qt, and it runs extensions in a sandbox.

File search reads the folders it indexes, your home folder by default. This package does not grant that access up front. To turn it on, run: flatpak override --user --filesystem=home:ro org.tunaos.compass

description.p: Each release now carries the AppImage as a download. Distributions can ship system-wide default settings. Developers can use vici develop with Compass.
The first release of Compass on the TunaOS Flatpak remote.
